data.body:
REPAIRED. The updater ran green for the first time in two weeks: exit 0, and last-good.sha advanced
4dd9172b9 (Jul 17) -> 25fa6107f (main tip). TWO root causes, both needed — neither alone explains
every symptom, and fixing only the first still failed.

FIRST, A CORRECTION TO MY OWN EARLIER REPORT ON THIS TICKET. I said the build was ~4 days stale and
that the 0-byte launchd logs were the defect. Both wrong:
 * The failure began 2026-07-17T16:23:19Z, immediately after the last success at 15:16:40Z —
   294 CONSECUTIVE FAILED RUNS over TWO WEEKS, not 4 days. The Jul-27 code mtime I measured was a
   MANUAL pin (the doc documents that operation), which is what made the two records disagree.
 * The 0-byte launchd.{out,err}.log are BY DESIGN — the script redirects its own output to
   update.log (183 KB, and the actual evidence). I had not read update.log. Reading it named the
   cause on the first line.

ROOT CAUSE A — a stale uv SHADOWS a good one on the updater's own PATH.
  ~/.local/bin/uv          0.7.18  (2025-07-01), an orphaned 35 MB standalone binary
  /opt/homebrew/bin/uv     0.12.0  (2026-07-28), satisfies pipx
  ~/.langflow/uv                   the copy the standalone installer actually manages
Line 33 exported PATH="${HOME}/.local/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:..." — ~/.local/bin FIRST — so pipx
resolved 0.7.18, and pipx >=1.8 requires uv>=0.9.17. Every run died at that check.
Reproduced directly: under that exact PATH, `command -v uv` -> ~/.local/bin/uv, 0.7.18.
`uv self update` CANNOT fix it: it refuses because the standalone installer manages ~/.langflow/uv,
not this path. FIX: put /opt/homebrew/bin ahead of ~/.local/bin. ~/.local/bin stays on PATH — it
holds the pipx-installed `rebar` shim the smoke test invokes; only precedence changed.

ROOT CAUSE B — the pipx venv was PINNED to the pip backend, and pip cannot resolve this package.
Fixing A alone STILL FAILED. ~/.local/pipx/venvs/nava-rebar/pipx_metadata.json recorded
`backend = pip`, and pipx's own help states the rule: the backend "Defaults to ... 'uv' when uv is
available ... else 'pip'. EXISTING VENVS ALWAYS HONOR THEIR" original backend. So a good uv on PATH
changed nothing. pip then failed with `error: resolution-too-deep` — this package installs NINE
extras (agents,dev,eval,grounding,grounding-t2,mcp,reviewbot,tracing,ui) and pip backtracks through
click/fsspec and gives up. pipx's surface message ("pip seemed to fail to build package: click...")
is MISLEADING — nothing was building; the resolver quit.
Proved not overridable: `pipx install ... --force --backend uv` was IGNORED — same
resolution-too-deep, metadata still `backend = pip`. FIX: `pipx uninstall nava-rebar` then a fresh
install, which adopted `backend = uv` and succeeded.

A WRONG FIX I TRIED AND REVERTED, recorded so nobody repeats it: `--backend pip`, which is the
workaround ticket 72ca documents for this error. It DOES clear cause A's error, and then fails on
cause B. **--backend pip is not viable for this package** — uv is a hard requirement here, not a
preference, because only uv resolves the nine-extra graph. 72ca's documented workaround should say
so.

MUTATION CHECK: restoring the old PATH order reproduces the exact uv error, so the one-line fix is
load-bearing rather than decorative. Post-fix state verified clean: backend=uv, nava-rebar 0.10.1,
`rebar list --help` exit 0, script diff = the PATH line plus its explanation, install line untouched.

STEP-6 REPLICATION of the reported symptom: the GLOBAL build now parses the dict-shaped `activate`
— `registry.effective_criteria('.')` returns 44 effective criteria where it previously raised
CriteriaError. The silent gate degradation is gone.

AWS IS NOT INVOLVED. The operator suggested AWS CLI access might be relevant; it is not. The updater
installs from `git+https://github.com/navapbc/rebar.git` and touches no AWS service. No AWS calls
were made.

THIS TICKET STAYS OPEN. The ENVIRONMENT is repaired, but two ACs are code work and are NOT done:
distinguishing an overlay CriteriaError from an LLM outage, and naming the installed build as the
suspect in that case. Those are the durable fix — the reason this cost two weeks is that a broken
INSTALL presented as an unreviewable TICKET. The environment repair does not prevent a recurrence.
